warmups.name: Scapular Mobility (Shoulder Blade Glides)
warmups.precautions: Seated tall, arms relaxed;Glide shoulder blades up, down, together and apart in slow circles;Keep the neck long and still;Full comfortable range, no forcing
warmups.cues: Circle the shoulder blades;Slow full glides;Neck stays long

exercises.name: DB Shrug
exercises.precautions: Stand tall, arms straight and still at sides;Lift shoulders straight up to ears - no rolling;Head neutral, chin level, no jutting forward;Pause at top - feel it in upper traps
exercises.cues: Arms straight, stand tall;Lift shoulders to ears;Pause, then lower slowly

exercises.name: Cable Shrug
exercises.precautions: Stand tall, arms straight and still in front;Head neutral, chin level - no jutting forward;Shoulders lift straight UP - never roll them;Lift through upper traps only
exercises.cues: Grip bar low in front;Shrug shoulders to ears;Pause, then lower slowly

exercises.name: Farmer's Carry
exercises.precautions: Stand tall - shoulders down and back, chest up;Arms straight at sides, weights not touching thighs;Walk heel-to-toe, steps short and even;Head level - look straight ahead, never down
exercises.cues: Pick up heavy dumbbells;Walk tall and slow;Set down with a flat back

exercises.name: KB High Pull (Light)
exercises.precautions: Feet hip-width, hinge at hips, flat back;Bell starts between feet - arms straight, lats tight;Stand tall - no leaning back at the top;Elbows end high, pointing back - wrists below elbows
exercises.cues: Hinge and grip the bell;Snap hips to stand;Pull elbows high, lower with control

exercises.name: Shoulder Shrugs
exercises.precautions: Stand tall, arms relaxed at your sides;Lift both shoulders straight up toward your ears;Do not roll them - straight up, then straight down;Lower fully between reps so your neck stays loose
exercises.cues: Shoulders up to ears;Pause at the top;Drop them fully, repeat

exercises.name: Scapular Squeeze
exercises.precautions: Stand or sit tall, arms relaxed at your sides;Squeeze your shoulder blades together and down;Hold 3 seconds without shrugging;Keep your chest open and neck relaxed
exercises.cues: Blades together and down;Hold for 3 seconds;Release slowly, repeat

exercises.name: Neck Rotations
exercises.precautions: Slow half or full circles - never force the range;Keep shoulders down and still;Stop if you feel dizzy;Never crank the neck backward hard
exercises.cues: Slow gentle circles;Shoulders stay down;Breathe easy

exercises.name: Neck Circles (Upward Dog)
exercises.precautions: In a gentle upward dog, circle your head slowly;Keep circles small and smooth;Shoulders stay down away from your ears;Stop if dizzy
exercises.cues: Gentle up-dog;Small slow head circles;Shoulders stay down

stretches.name: Neck Trapezius Stretch
stretches.precautions: Move gently until you feel a mild stretch - never force;Breathe slowly and relax into it - no bouncing;Keep posture tall and supported where you can
stretches.cues: Move gently to a mild stretch;Breathe slowly, never force it
